description: 24,751 mapped historical wildfire perimeters from the BC Wildfire Service. Published by BC Wildfire Service (Province of British Columbia) as [BC Wildfire Fire Perimeters - Historical](https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/bc-wildfire-fire-perimeters-historical) in the BC Data Catalogue; this is a full province-wide mirror. Query recipes and field notes are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

table:columns.name: FIRE_NUMBER
table:columns.description: FIRE_NUMBER is a composite of the following fields: Zone, Fire ID and Fire Centre.

table:columns.name: VERSION_NUMBER
table:columns.description: VERSION_NUMBER represents the unique versions of the collected data. As additional data is tracked for an incident, new data will be stored in the datastore for the same incident. A new record is added with an incremented version number.

table:columns.name: FIRE_YEAR
table:columns.description: FIRE_YEAR represents the fiscal year, April 1 to March 31.

table:columns.name: FIRE_CAUSE
table:columns.description: FIRE_CAUSE is the suspected cause of the fire, e.g., Lightning, Person.

table:columns.name: FIRE_LABEL
table:columns.description: FIRE_LABEL is the concatenation of Fire Number and Fire Year.

table:columns.name: FIRE_SIZE_HECTARES
table:columns.description: FIRE_SIZE_HECTARES indicates the area within the outside perimeter of the incident, in hectares.

table:columns.name: SOURCE
table:columns.description: SOURCE identifies the method used to create the spatial data for load into the datastore.

table:columns.name: GPS_TRACK_DATE
table:columns.description: GPS_TRACK_DATE represents the date the incident was initially tracked via GPS.

table:columns.name: LOAD_DATE
table:columns.description: LOAD_DATE epresents the date the incident was initially loaded into the datastore.

table:columns.name: FIRE_DATE
table:columns.description: FIRE_DATE represent the date and time when the incident was reported.

table:columns.name: CREATION_METHOD
table:columns.description: The Creation Method identifies the method used to collect the spatial data.

table:columns.name: FEATURE_CODE
table:columns.description: FEATURE_CODE contains an alphanumeric value based on the Canadian Council of Surveys and Mapping’s (CCSM) system for classification of geographic features, e.g., AR82000110.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: OBJECTID is a column required by spatial layers that interact with ESRI ArcSDE. It is populated with unique values automatically by SDE.

table:columns.name: SE_ANNO_CAD_DATA
table:columns.description: SE_ANNO_CAD_DATA is a binary column used by spatial tools to store annotation, curve features and CAD data when using the SDO_GEOMETRY storage data type.

table:columns.name: FEATURE_AREA_SQM
table:columns.description: FEATURE_AREA_SQM is the system calculated area of a two-dimensional polygon in square meters

table:columns.name: FEATURE_LENGTH_M
table:columns.description: FEATURE_LENGTH_M is the system calculated length or perimeter of a geometry in meters

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>

title: BC Wildfire Fire Perimeters - Historical
